poly-will-gyanesh-kumar-be-out-as-chief-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Gyanesh Kumar leaves office as India's Chief Election Commissioner by the deadline. The post runs national and state votes, and removal requires the same process as for a Supreme Court judge.
poly-will-gyanesh-kumar-be-out-as-chief-.recent: The INDIA bloc's campaign against him peaked with a march on New Delhi, where thousands demanded the election chief resign over revisions to the voter rolls. Kharge had said in Patna that those revisions stole 4 state governments. The rally passed with no resignation and no step toward forcing one.

stocks:2317.TW.standing: Hon Hai, trading as Foxconn, is the Taiwanese contract manufacturer that assembles most of the world's iPhones and a growing share of AI servers. Its share price is a read on demand from Apple and the large data-centre builders.

stocks:ZURN.SW.standing: Zurich Insurance is a Swiss insurer selling property, casualty and life cover worldwide, with a large North American commercial book through Farmers ties. Its profits turn on catastrophe claims, pricing cycles and investment returns on premiums.

poly-france-declares-state-of-emergency-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether France declares a state of emergency. The 1955 law behind it lets the government impose curfews, ban gatherings and order house searches, and was used in the 2005 riots and after the 2015 Paris attacks.

poly-will-syria-join-the-mecca-agreement.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Syria joins the Mecca Agreement, a regional defence pact, within the contract's 2026 deadline. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it tracks Damascus's alignment with the pact's members.

stocks:MDA.TO.standing: A Canadian space company that builds satellite systems, antennas and robotics, including the Canadarm arms flown on the Space Shuttle and the International Space Station. Its shares turn on large constellation contracts.
stocks:MDA.TO.recent: MDA Space agreed with Thales Alenia Space to build digital antennas for the first 66 satellites of IRIS2, the EU's secure connectivity constellation, under a €64 million deal announced on 30 October, as Canada and the EU explore Canadian participation. The deal came after the share's slide and does not account for it.

stocks:RIO.standing: One of the world's largest miners, listed in London and Sydney and traded in New York through depositary shares. Iron ore from Australia's Pilbara drives its earnings, which ties the share closely to Chinese steel demand.
stocks:RIO.recent: Rio Tinto halted underground operations at Oyu Tolgoi, the copper mine at the centre of its push beyond iron ore, as the slide reached its end. The stoppage came without a stated reason, and nothing else reported in the period accounts for the weeks of decline before it.

stocks:BHP.standing: An Anglo-Australian miner and one of the world's largest, listed in New York through American depositary receipts. Iron ore and copper drive its earnings, so its shares carry exposure to Chinese steel demand and global industrial activity.

stocks:NWSA.standing: Owner of The Wall Street Journal, The Times of London, HarperCollins books and a controlling stake in Australia's REA Group. Its value rests on Dow Jones subscriptions and property listings more than on newspaper sales.
stocks:NWSA.recent: A judge in Miami dismissed Trump's defamation suit against the company's Wall Street Journal and ruled that he cannot refile it. The ruling was reported after the last close on this chart, so it accounts for none of the price, and nothing else in the fortnight's news explains the share's move.

poly-will-helen-zille-be-the-next-mayor-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Helen Zille, the former Cape Town mayor and Western Cape premier, becomes Johannesburg's next mayor. The city council elects the mayor, so coalition deals can matter as much as the vote.

poly-will-iran-withdraw-from-the-npt-bef.standing: A Polymarket contract on Iran formally quitting the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty by 2027. The treaty lets a member leave on three months' notice, and leaving would end the legal basis for inspections of Iran's sites.
poly-will-iran-withdraw-from-the-npt-bef.recent: A Mehr report that Iran's parliament would unanimously quit the nuclear treaty did not hold the price up. In the days after, Trump answered "no" on striking Iran after the midterms, Tehran offered to reopen Hormuz and set five conditions for regional security, and Democrats took both chambers on a vote Vance called "the reason we lost".

wiki-bitcoin.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on bitcoin each day. Bitcoin is a digital currency with a capped supply and no central issuer, so price shocks, hacks and rule changes send newcomers to look it up.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: Chainalysis confirmed at least $5.9 billion stolen from Binance in a hack linked to North Korea. Binance says it has replaced 90% of it, and customers pulled a net $4.72 billion once withdrawals reopened. On election night the CLARITY Act, the industry's market-structure bill, stalled 49 to 50 in the Senate.

stocks:0020.HK.standing: A Chinese artificial-intelligence company listed in Hong Kong, known for computer vision and facial recognition and now also building large language models. US limits on its access to American technology and investors shape its business.
stocks:0020.HK.recent: SenseTime's one recent piece of news, the release of a model that runs 24 layers twice, came after the last close on this chart, so it accounts for none of this price.

poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if U.S. forces invade Iran before 2027; its price is what traders will pay for that outcome. It asks about an invasion, a far higher bar than an air or missile strike.
poly-will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.recent: Democrats took both chambers of Congress on an anti-war vote, and Vance called the Iran war 'the reason we lost'. Trump answered 'no' on striking Iran after the midterms even as Netanyahu pressed him to, while the Doha talks carried Tehran's five conditions and its offer of a two-day Hormuz reopening.

stocks:RYA.IR.standing: Shares of Europe's biggest low-cost airline, based in Dublin and flying a fleet of Boeing 737s. Fuel is among its largest costs, so the oil price reaches its profits directly, as does how much of its fuel it has hedged.
stocks:RYA.IR.recent: Ryanair froze pay after saying it expects its jet fuel bill to rise €2bn next year. That news came after the last close shown here, so it accounts for none of this price action.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-democr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic senator from Georgia, becomes his party's presidential nominee in 2028. Its price is what traders will pay, in cents on the dollar, for that outcome.

poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States ends its blockade of Iran by the close of 2026. The price is what traders will pay for that outcome, which is tied to whether Gulf oil reaches its importers.
poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.recent: Tehran cut its offer to reopen Hormuz from 7 days to 2 and set five conditions, including recognition of its sovereignty over the strait. After Democrats took both chambers, Trump said the war ends 'whenever I want it to', and Mojtaba Khamenei said the vote would not soften US hostility.

stocks:MARUTI.NS.standing: India's largest carmaker, majority-owned by Japan's Suzuki Motor and built on small, affordable cars. Its sales are among the clearest readings of what Indian households feel able to spend on a big purchase.
stocks:MARUTI.NS.recent: Carmakers dispatched an estimated 525,000 cars to dealers in October, with Maruti leading the festive stocking. These are shipments to showrooms, not sales to buyers, so the figure records how much stock dealers took on for the season.

stocks:3690.HK.standing: China's largest food-delivery and local-services platform, listed in Hong Kong. Its shares answer to subsidy wars with rivals at home, Beijing's rules for platform companies, and the cost of expanding abroad.
stocks:3690.HK.recent: Meituan's delivery arm Keeta found more than half of the Rio chain outlets it targeted already locked into exclusive deals with iFood. The company also released LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model fitted onto Chinese chips with under 80GB of memory. Neither event accounts for the share price.

stocks:CA.PA.standing: A French supermarket group running hypermarkets and convenience stores across France, Spain and Brazil. Its thin margins make the share sensitive to food prices, household budgets and price wars with rivals such as Leclerc.

stocks:0941.HK.standing: China's largest mobile network operator by subscribers, controlled by the state and listed in Hong Kong. Its steady cash flow and dividends draw income investors, and its network spending drives orders across China's telecom and computing suppliers.

stocks:MRVL.standing: A US chip designer whose silicon moves data rather than running applications: custom AI processors, optical links and networking chips for data centres. Its fortunes rest heavily on the spending of a few large cloud companies.
stocks:MRVL.recent: The one story about Marvell itself is its $115 billion takeover of Lumentum, a company that began as a $1 billion spinoff, in a deal Nvidia's Huang is reported to have blessed. Bloomberg framed it alongside Meta's cross-border bond sale as AI debt. Nothing in the input explains the slide that came before the deal.

stocks:LITE.standing: An American maker of the lasers and optical components that carry data through telecom networks and inside large data centres. Its fortunes follow what cloud companies spend on AI infrastructure.

stocks:0728.HK.standing: One of China's three state-controlled telecom carriers, selling mobile, broadband and cloud services. Its shares show what investors will pay for a steady, dividend-paying state operator that is also building computing capacity for AI.

poly-israel-x-hamas-ceasefire-cancelled-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Israel-Hamas ceasefire is cancelled by Dec 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it reacts to fighting in Gaza and to the politics of the governments behind the truce.
poly-israel-x-hamas-ceasefire-cancelled-.recent: The truce outlasted Israel's election and the Shin Bet's rebuttal of Netanyahu's claim of Arab voter fraud, while Israeli strikes still killed Palestinians in Gaza and Israel shut the Rafah crossing to aid. None of it ended the ceasefire, and none of it accounts for the late-October rise in what traders paid for a collapse.

poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-decembe.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the United States and Iran reach an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz by December 31. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, on a waterway that Gulf energy exporters and importers depend on.
poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-decembe.recent: Tehran answered a US ceasefire proposal with five conditions, including recognition of its sovereignty over Hormuz, as US strikes on Qeshm Island and mines that set four tankers ablaze kept the strait contested. After Democrats took both chambers, Mojtaba Khamenei said the vote changes nothing, and Trump said the war ends whenever he wants it to.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the Federal Reserve raises its policy rate by a quarter point at its December meeting. That rate anchors short-term dollar borrowing, so bonds, mortgages and currencies worldwide reprice around it.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: The Fed held on Wednesday with a nod to December, against a hold that TD Securities expected to draw 3 dissents, and Warsh's muddled messaging afterwards revived doubts about Fed credibility. The election then gave Democrats control of confirming every future Fed governor, so the Senate can block nominees picked to push rates down.

stocks:GILD.standing: Gilead Sciences is a US drugmaker built on antivirals, and among the largest suppliers of HIV medicines, including the twice-yearly prevention shot lenacapavir. Its shares turn on how long those drugs hold their pricing and on what follows them.
stocks:GILD.recent: A generic version of Gilead's twice-yearly HIV-prevention shot, lenacapavir, was cleared for low-income countries at an expected $40 a year instead of $28,218. That news came after the rise, and nothing in the input explains the share price.

stocks:TSLA.standing: Shares of the US electric-car and battery maker led by Elon Musk. Its valuation rests far more on promised robotaxis and robots than on the cars it sells today, so the stock often moves on Musk's plans as much as on its results.
stocks:TSLA.recent: The late-October climb came as SpaceX was reported to be considering a merger with Tesla, a deal that would make Elon Musk $100 billion richer. Barclays then called the merger a key part of the bull case for the shares, while other analysts argued it would be a bad move for Tesla's holders.

poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-novembe.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Washington and Tehran reach an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz by November 30. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, on the waterway that carries Gulf oil and gas to the world.
poly-us-iran-hormuz-agreement-by-novembe.recent: Iran answered a US ceasefire proposal with five conditions, including recognition of its sovereignty over Hormuz. US strikes hit Qeshm Island the same day, and 4 tankers burned after hitting mines. Mojtaba Khamenei said the Democratic sweep would not change US behaviour, and Trump said the war ends whenever he wants.

wiki-united-states-dollar.standing: The currency of the United States and the world's main reserve and trading money. Most oil, debt and cross-border trade is priced in it, so its swings set borrowing costs and import bills far beyond America.
wiki-united-states-dollar.recent: Brazil's real futures fell 10% when Lula beat the market's pick. Two days later, foreign flows into US equities hit a record on the AI boom: money chasing returns rather than shelter, which tested the dollar's standing as a safe haven.

wiki-binance.standing: The Wikipedia article on Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Millions of retail traders hold funds on it, and much of the market's stablecoin and token liquidity clears through its order books.
wiki-binance.recent: Binance froze funds after Chainalysis confirmed at least $5.9 billion stolen, and the FBI blamed North Korea's TraderTraitor for a $6.3 billion theft that Binance traced to malicious code and a fake job interview. Pyongyang denied it; Binance says it refilled 90% of the loss, yet customers pulled a net $4.72 billion once withdrawals reopened.

stocks:SHA0.DE.standing: Shares of the Herzogenaurach maker of bearings, transmission parts and electric drives, one of Germany's largest car-industry suppliers. Its earnings follow carmakers' output and how fast the industry shifts to electric.
stocks:SHA0.DE.recent: Schaeffler is cutting 3,500 jobs and closing four German sites, with three quarters of the losses in Germany, as the crisis in Germany's car industry moves down the supply chain from the carmakers to their suppliers. The cuts were announced after the last price on this chart, so they do not explain its slide.

stocks:688036.SS.standing: The Shenzhen maker of Tecno, Itel and Infinix phones, sold cheaply across Africa, South Asia and the Middle East. Thin margins on low-priced handsets leave it exposed to the cost of the chips inside them.
stocks:688036.SS.recent: The one story about Transsion's own business was a cost squeeze: memory now exceeds 60% of the parts cost of sub-$100 phones, the segment it sells into. That pressure on margins runs against the rally, and nothing else in the input accounts for the rise.

poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if shipping through the Strait of Hormuz returns to normal by December 31. Roughly a fifth of the world's oil passes the strait, so the price is a bet on Gulf supply reopening.
poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.recent: Iran's reopening offer shrank from 7 days to 2, and its five conditions for a deal include recognition of its sovereignty over Hormuz. The Revolutionary Guards say tankers on an unauthorized route hit mines, the US struck Qeshm Island, and Tehran says four tankers are still burning.

stocks:2222.SR.standing: Saudi Arabia's state oil company and the world's largest crude producer, with a small slice listed on the Riyadh exchange. The state owns nearly all of it, so its dividend is a pillar of the Saudi budget.
stocks:2222.SR.recent: Aramco's third-quarter profit rose 9% to $31.2 billion on the higher oil prices the Hormuz crisis produced, and the same day it began expanding an export route that bypasses the strait. Brent had hit $110.63 after a Houthi drone strike near the Shaybah field, showing the war reaches Aramco's own fields as well as its prices.

stocks:9984.T.standing: Masayoshi Son's Tokyo-listed investment holding company, which owns most of chip designer Arm and has staked heavily on OpenAI. Its shares trade as a leveraged bet on the value of those AI holdings.
stocks:9984.T.recent: The one story in these weeks about SoftBank's own business was a deal for Sceye to fly stratospheric cell towers over Japan, and nothing in it accounts for the slide in the share.

stocks:1810.HK.standing: Shares of Xiaomi, the Beijing maker of smartphones, home appliances and electric cars, listed in Hong Kong. It is one of the world's largest phone sellers, and its car business is the bet investors price on top of that.

stocks:603486.SS.standing: A Suzhou-based maker of home robots, best known for its Deebot robot vacuums, listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. It competes for the same living rooms as Roborock and Dreame, and sells heavily abroad.

stocks:SK.PA.standing: Groupe SEB, the French maker of Tefal pans, Moulinex and Rowenta appliances and WMF cookware, and the world's largest small-appliance company. Its share tracks household spending in Europe and China.

stocks:PHIA.AS.standing: Philips, the Dutch maker of hospital scanners, patient monitors and sleep-apnoea devices, listed in Amsterdam after shedding its lighting and appliance arms. A recall of its Respironics breathing machines weighed on it for years.

stocks:300866.SZ.standing: A Changsha consumer-electronics maker best known for Anker chargers and power banks, Soundcore audio and eufy home devices. Most of its sales are overseas, much through Amazon, so US tariffs and platform rules reach it directly.

stocks:BLK.standing: The world's largest asset manager, best known for its iShares exchange-traded funds. Its fees are a slice of the assets it runs, so its shares track markets and the flow of money into its funds.

stocks:MSFT.standing: Shares of the maker of Windows, Office and the Azure cloud, one of the largest companies by market value. Its price now rides on whether heavy spending on AI data centres comes back as cloud revenue.
stocks:MSFT.recent: Microsoft offered buyouts to 60,000 staff to contain costs while forecasting $175 billion in capital spending this year for its AI push. The share then slid as tech earnings deepened doubts over what that AI spending returns, and PC revenue behind Windows fell.

stocks:AMD.standing: Designs the processors in PCs, servers and game consoles, built under contract by TSMC. It is Intel's only rival in x86 chips and Nvidia's nearest challenger in the accelerators that train and run AI models.
stocks:AMD.recent: AMD's third quarter doubled its data-center business, with revenue there up 97% to $8.55 billion on AI chip demand while gaming cratered, and its sales forecast topped estimates. A week earlier it joined Nvidia and Broadcom in eyeing up to $5 billion of Meta's $95 billion stock sale, raised to pay for AI data centres.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei, Taiwan's capital, a post long held by the Kuomintang and often a stepping stone to the presidency.

poly-will-christine-lagarde-win-the-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Christine Lagarde, a former French finance minister who has run the IMF and the ECB, wins France's 2027 presidential election, an open race since Emmanuel Macron cannot run again.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the ceasefire between Israel and Iran is still in force on Nov 7. Its price is what traders will pay on the truce surviving, with Washington's next decision on strikes as the swing factor.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Traders paid more for the truce after Trump answered "no" on striking Iran after the midterms, and Iran offered a two-day Hormuz reopening while setting five conditions for regional security. Democrats then took both chambers on an anti-war vote, and Vance called the Iran war "the reason we lost".

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio becomes the Republican candidate for president in 2028. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it trades against the field of rivals to succeed Trump.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance, the US vice-president, wins the 2028 presidential election. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and it tracks his standing as heir to the Republican nomination.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.recent: Democrats won the midterms in a landslide, taking the House and the Senate with flips in Texas, Kansas, Maine and South Carolina, and voters named the Iran war and fuel prices as the cause. Vance blamed the defeat on anger over the war and clashed publicly with Trump over it.

wiki-european-central-bank.standing: The central bank of the countries that share the euro, based in Frankfurt. It sets their interest rates and supervises their largest banks, so its decisions reach mortgages, savings and government borrowing across the bloc.
wiki-european-central-bank.recent: Christine Lagarde said she would leave the European Central Bank on 7 February 2027, cutting short her eight-year term on the day it held rates. The 21 euro-area governments must nominate a successor by Nov. 6, while inflation at 4%, double the target, has the Bundesbank's Nagel backing a December hike.

poly-trump-out-as-president-before-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Donald Trump leaves the presidency before 2027, by death, resignation or removal. Removal takes a House impeachment and a two-thirds Senate vote to convict, a bar no president has ever cleared.
poly-trump-out-as-president-before-2027.recent: Democrats flipped 6 Senate seats and took the House in a vote fought over the Iran war, and Vance broke with Trump in public, calling the war "the reason we lost". Trump replied that the war ends "whenever I want it to", claiming sole authority over a war Congress never declared and that the new Congress takes up in January.

poly-iran-leadership-change-by-november-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Iran's top leadership changes before its deadline, priced as what traders will pay for that outcome. Iran's Supreme Leader has the final word on war, the nuclear programme and Hormuz.
poly-iran-leadership-change-by-november-.recent: Bets on a change at the top in Tehran faded as the war turned toward talks. Trump answered "no" on striking Iran after the midterms, though Netanyahu pressed him to, and Iran set five conditions for a ceasefire and offered a two-day Hormuz reopening. After the Democratic sweep, Mojtaba Khamenei told Iranians not to expect any change in US behaviour.

stocks:8058.T.standing: Japan's largest general trading house, listed in Tokyo, with stakes in liquefied natural gas, copper, coking coal, food and car distribution. Its earnings move with commodity prices more than with the Japanese economy.
stocks:8058.T.recent: The climb ended on a raised forecast: the company now expects record ¥1.2 trillion net income, part of a wider windfall in which Japan's trading houses are profiting from war-driven commodity prices, copper among them.

stocks:VNA.DE.standing: Germany's largest residential landlord, owning several hundred thousand flats across Germany, Sweden and Austria. Its share price moves with interest rates, which set the value of its debt-funded portfolio, and with rent rules.
stocks:VNA.DE.recent: Elif Eralp, the far-left candidate likely to lead Berlin's next government, pledged to expropriate more than 200,000 housing units from large landlords, acting on the 2021 referendum that backed it. Vonovia, Germany's biggest landlord, called the plan legally questionable; the fight turns on what compensation the public purse would pay.

stocks:8031.T.standing: One of Japan's largest general trading houses, or sogo shosha, earning much of its profit from stakes in Australian iron ore mines and LNG projects. Its earnings follow commodity prices more than Japan's own economy.

wiki-democratic-party-united-states.standing: The Wikipedia article on the Democratic Party, the older of America's two major parties, founded in 1828. Its daily reads count people looking the party up, not support for it, and they rise around elections and leadership fights.
wiki-democratic-party-united-states.recent: The midterms ended in a Democratic sweep that sent gold up 3% and left the CLARITY Act stalled 49 to 50 in the Senate. The run-up was fought over Alaska, where the Justice Department sued to block certification only if the Republican lost, and Michigan, where Trump called Senate candidate El-Sayed a jihadist; 43 million Americans voted early.

stocks:GS.standing: The share price of Goldman Sachs, the New York investment bank listed on the NYSE. Its earnings ride on mergers, share issuance and trading volumes, so the stock tends to track how busy Wall Street's dealmaking is.

poly-will-ukraine-sign-an-eu-accession-t.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Ukraine signs its EU accession treaty by 2027. Signing comes only after every negotiating chapter closes and all 27 member states agree, so the price is a bet on the pace of talks in Brussels.
poly-will-ukraine-sign-an-eu-accession-t.recent: The European Commission's enlargement report split Ukraine from Moldova, the country it applied alongside, and proposed that Moldova finish its membership talks a year earlier. It blamed Ukraine's sputtering anti-corruption effort, so Kyiv's courts and graft bodies, not the front line, now set its pace.

stocks:0763.HK.standing: A Shenzhen maker of mobile-network equipment and phones, listed in Hong Kong and Shenzhen and second in China only to Huawei. A 2018 US export ban nearly shut it down, so US chip rules weigh on its shares.

stocks:QCOM.standing: Shares in Qualcomm, the San Diego chip designer whose Snapdragon processors run most premium Android phones and whose cellular patents earn a royalty on most handsets. It rises and falls with the smartphone cycle and Chinese demand.
stocks:QCOM.recent: The one development about the company's own business was in Shanghai, where Qualcomm showed a public 6G prototype reaching peak speeds near 14 Gbps. It was a demonstration, not an order, a ruling or a set of results, and nothing in the input ties it to the share price.

wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.standing: Daily reads of the Wikipedia article on Benjamin Netanyahu, the Likud politician who is Israel's longest-serving prime minister and has shaped its politics, security policy and ties with Washington for three decades.
wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.recent: Israel voted on Tuesday and neither Netanyahu's bloc nor Eisenkot's reached 61 seats without Arab parties. Netanyahu then alleged fraud by Arab voters, a claim Shin Bet said its probe does not support, and Herzog has opened coalition talks in which 19 Arab-party seats decide who governs.

poly-pete-hegseth-out-as-secretary-of-de.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Pete Hegseth stops being the US Secretary of Defense before the end of the year. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on reports about his standing at the Pentagon.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, is valued below $1.25 trillion when its shares first list. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-pete-hegseth-out-as-secretary-of-de.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Pete Hegseth no longer holds the post of US Secretary of Defense by the end of November. Its price is what traders will pay for his departure, so it moves on news about his standing with the White House.

poly-will-crude-oil-reach-a-new-all-time.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if crude oil sets a new all-time high before the end of the year. The price is what traders will stake on a supply shock big enough to push the barrel past its record.

poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz returns to normal by Nov 30. The strait carries much of the world's seaborne oil and Gulf LNG, so this is a bet on Gulf energy exports flowing freely.
poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.recent: Iran's offer to reopen the strait shrank from 7 days to 2. Then the US struck Qeshm Island, and Tehran said four tankers were ablaze after hitting mines. One of Iran's five conditions for a deal is recognition of its sovereignty over Hormuz, which would put any reopening on Tehran's terms.

poly-will-samuel-alito-announce-his-reti.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Justice Samuel Alito announces his retirement from the US Supreme Court before 2026 ends. His departure would let the sitting president and Senate fill a seat in the court's conservative majority.

stocks:BILI.standing: Shares of Bilibili, the Shanghai-based video platform popular with China's young viewers, listed on Nasdaq. Its revenue rests on games, advertising and paying members, so the stock tracks Chinese youth spending and Beijing's rules for games.

stocks:WULF.standing: A former bitcoin miner with zero-carbon power sites in New York and Pennsylvania that now leases data-center capacity to AI companies. Its share trades on whether those long leases get signed and financed.
stocks:WULF.recent: The news about TeraWulf's own business came after this decline. Google agreed it can take over Anthropic's $19 billion data center lease, and TeraWulf is borrowing on that backstop. Nothing reported in the window accounts for the fall that came before it.

poly-will-nvidia-be-the-largest-company-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Nvidia is the world's most valuable listed company by market capitalisation at year end. Its price is what traders will pay on Nvidia staying ahead of rivals like Apple and Microsoft.

poly-putin-out-as-president-of-russia-by.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Vladimir Putin leaves Russia's presidency before 2027. He has led Russia since 1999 with no named successor, so the price is a bet on death, illness or a palace upheaval.
poly-putin-out-as-president-of-russia-by.recent: The fortnight put Putin at the table rather than near the exit: the leaders of Norway and Finland held rare talks with him, the first US-mediated Ukraine-Russia talks since February were set for Abu Dhabi on 10 November, and a Melania Trump-brokered truce let an aid convoy into Oleshky. None of it touched his hold on power.

poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Washington and Tehran sign a final agreement on Iran's nuclear programme before the end of 2026. Such a deal would set limits on Iran's uranium enrichment and on the sanctions against its oil.
poly-us-iran-final-nuclear-deal-by-decem.recent: Tehran hardened as the midterms approached: its Hormuz offer fell from 7 days to 2, a commander set five conditions including recognition of its sovereignty over Hormuz, and a lawmaker said parliament would unanimously quit the nuclear treaty. After the Democratic sweep, Mojtaba Khamenei said partisan shifts would not soften US hostility.

wiki-data-center.standing: A building packed with servers, storage and networking gear that runs cloud services and trains AI models. The largest draw as much power as a small city, which ties them to local grids, water supplies and household bills.
wiki-data-center.recent: On election day voters rejected data centers in 38 of 40-plus local contests, and Hinojosa's win in the Texas governor's race left projects there uncertain in a state that had already suspended 17 permits. The backlash rests on power bills, up over 20% in two years in Ohio, and over 100 groups plan protests across Europe from Friday.

stocks:2899.HK.standing: A Fujian-based Chinese miner, listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai, and one of the world's largest producers of copper and gold. Its mines run from Congo to Serbia, so its shares move with the prices of both metals.

stocks:MU.standing: An American maker of memory chips: the DRAM and NAND flash that hold data in phones, PCs and servers. Its high-bandwidth memory feeds AI accelerators, so its shares swing with the memory cycle and data-centre spending.
stocks:MU.recent: About 12 Micron workers in Taoyuan staged Taiwan's first chip-industry strike, and the company paused work on its $4.5 billion Taiwan plant after the labor spat. The same Thursday its shares fell 11%, alongside Nvidia and AMD, as chip stocks slid after the midterms.

stocks:005930.KS.standing: South Korea's largest company and the world's biggest maker of memory chips, which go into phones, PCs and AI data centres. It carries the heaviest weight in the KOSPI, so its share price moves the whole Seoul market.
stocks:005930.KS.recent: The company's own news over the fortnight was a retreat from selling fridges and washing machines in Hong Kong, part of a wider pullback from China, and a $229 pair of Galaxy Buds. Neither accounts for the share's slide.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest chipmaker and a leading supplier of the high-bandwidth memory stacked beside AI accelerators. Its shares move with data-centre spending and the price of memory chips.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: SK hynix shelved a Solidigm listing worth up to $15 billion while its own record US listing sat underwater, and its ADR rallied the same day. Five days later its gains lifted chip stocks ahead of the Fed decision and earnings. Nothing in the fortnight's reporting accounts for the slide in early October.
